headline: Base Turnover Surges in The Gutter as Northern Sectors Shift
war_summary: Since the last dispatch, the focal point of base instability has pivoted sharply into The Gutter, where ten strategic base transitions occurred over the past two hours across positions like Kuoppa and Lost Kaivo despite modest casualty rates. Weathered Expanse remains deeply volatile, adding seven fresh base transfers in the same span around Spirit Watch and Necropolis to leave four positions reduced to no-man's-land even as casualty rates taper. Palantine Berm recorded three further exchanges at Vendett, maintaining persistent churn along the berm line, while Stlican Shelf saw new movement at Breaker Town. By contrast, the previously contested sectors of Marban Hollow and Linn of Mercy have quieted over the past two hours, with Linn of Mercy's earlier casualty surge dropping off considerably. Callahan's Passage persists as an attritional grinder, absorbing more than thirteen hundred combined casualties over the past two hours under accelerating casualty rates without shifting any strategic flags. Nevish Line similarly reports no fresh territorial turnover in recent hours despite substantial ongoing casualties.
